free_text: The decision leans towards biopsy because the statistical prior suggested it, and the retrieved evidence showed a significant PSA rise from 3.1 ng/mL to 9.3 ng/mL, coupled with a PI-RADS 5 lesion. Although the prior biopsy confirmed ISUP grade group 3 disease, the significant PSA trajectory and high-risk imaging findings provide sufficient justification to pursue further tissue sampling to refine staging and treatment planning.
